title: New Builds in Central Texas: Kiella Homebuilders
description:
➡️Ready to buy a new home in the Central Texas area? Schedule a call here: https://calendly.com/soldwithkyla/30min
 
I work with buyers and sellers throughout Central TX. Whether you're looking to buy land to build a custom home, already living local and looking to move for life changes, or you'll just be in Central Texas for a few years stationed at Fort Hood or completing you're Residency at BS&W, I've got you covered. 

Moving to or from Fort Hood or Central TX? We have real estate partners around the world to help get you sold and into a new home at your next destination!

Areas we cover: Temple, Belton, Salado, Troy, Killeen, Fort Hood, Harker Heights, Nolanville, Copperas Cove, Gatesville, Greater Waco area, and Greater Austin area. 

Kyla Montano | Licensed Texas REALTOR® (775318)

Welcome to another exclusive interview! Join @SoldWithKyla as we sit down with Jenifer Williams, a representative from Kiella Homebuilders, in Temple, TX. We cover everything a future homeowner would like to know, from prices, neighborhoods, the timeline of construction, and even the process involved in building your next home with Kiella Homebuilders. Jenifer also reveals some exclusive incentives that only a builder like Kiella can offer! You won't want to miss this powerful discussion filled with insider knowledge.

We dive into ALL the good stuff! From discussing the price range you can expect when building a home with Kiella Homebuilders to taking a look at the various neighborhoods they build in throughout the Temple area, helping you to visualize your dream home!

Ever wondered about the build timeline and process? That's covered! We'll discuss the details on how long it generally takes to construct a home and the streamlined processes Kiella uses to deliver exceptional quality on time!

From exploring exclusive builder incentives that could potentially save you thousands of dollars, to touring the various floor plans that can be tailored to your unique tastes and requirements, this interview brings value to every home buyer.  

Remember to subscribe and hit the notification bell so you'll never miss any of our exclusive builder interviews and home tours! Give us a thumbs up if the video provided value for you, and share it with anyone you know who is looking to build, buy, or sell a home in Temple, TX.

Feel free to leave any questions or comments you might have!
If you're ready to talk seriously about buying, book a call with Kyla below and let's get you into your next new home!
